standard_prerequisites.name: Descent criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Criterion (2)(c) certifies that gamma extends to A/p^e A once p^e A cap I is preserved.

standard_prerequisites.name: Limits of divided power rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the limit (A^^, I^^, gamma^^) in the category of divided power rings.

core_obligations: Pick t with p^t A subset I; realize A^^ -> A/I as a composition and prove surjectivity.
Identify the kernel as the p-adic completion of I via p^e I subset p^{e-t} I.
Prove continuity of gamma_n by the displayed expansion gamma_n(x + p^e y) = gamma_n(x) mod p^e I.
For e > t: show p^e A subset I is preserved via gamma_n(p^e a) = (p^n/n!) p^{n(e-1)} a^n in p^e A, using p^n/n! in Z_(p); conclude extension by the kernel criterion and the limit statement.
proof_roadmap: Run the four displayed computations: surjection, kernel, continuity, preservation; assemble the limit.
difficulty_reason: Four explicit computations chained; the preservation estimate is the only estimate and is displayed.
